## Description

Create `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/verifier.py` with functions to dispatch the `code-reviewer-verifier` agent, re-execute reviewer evidence commands against the reviewed SHA, and apply rulings to findings.

## Done Definitions

- `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/verifier.py` exists with:
  - `dispatch_verifier(findings, reviewed_sha, diff_text) -> list[dict]` — filters minor findings (bypass), calls verifier agent per critical/important/fragile finding, applies rulings; returns modified findings list
  - `re_execute_evidence_command(command, reviewed_sha)` — checks out file at `reviewed_sha` into a temp directory (read-only), runs `command` with output capture; raises `SandboxViolation` if command attempts network or write outside sandbox; returns stdout
  - `apply_ruling(finding, ruling)` — applies verifier ruling: `confirm` returns unchanged, `downgrade-to-minor` sets `severity: "minor"`, `drop` returns None
  - Sandboxing: read-only mount using Python subprocess with restricted PATH; no network (timeout 10s); only commands from a read allowlist (`grep`, `stat`, `ls`, `find`, `git show`)
  - `evidence_invalidated` computed: set to `True` when re-executed output differs from `verification_evidence.output`; passed to verifier agent in prompt
  - Verifier failure (timeout, API error, malformed ruling): annotates finding with `verifier_status: "failed"`, leaves finding unchanged (fail-open per-finding)
  - Minor findings: bypass verifier entirely, returned with `verifier_status` absent
- Running `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_verifier_dispatch.py` exits 0 after this task

## File Impact

- `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/verifier.py` — NEW

## Testing Mode

GREEN — makes T1 tests pass

## Implementation Notes

Evidence command re-execution contract:
- Output normalization: trim trailing whitespace and normalize absolute paths to relative before comparison (allows commands to work in a temp checkout dir without breaking comparison)
- Mismatch on normalized output → `evidence_invalidated: True`
- Document normalization contract in verifier.py module docstring so S2 agent guidance can reference it

Assumption (document in code): evidence commands are expected to be grep/stat/ls/find — commands that return deterministic output given the same file contents. Timestamp-generating commands (date, stat -c %Y) may produce non-deterministic output; verifier should warn but not fail if normalization cannot reconcile.
